about.label: About Us
about.quote1: Want to know why cute girls hate me?
about.quote2: We used to write code to solve problems. Now, we architect systems and orchestrate AI to write the code.
about.story: Tractors didn't replace farmers; they replaced the plow. AI won't replace developers, but an engineer driving the AI will absolutely replace the one still handwriting boilerplate. By integrating AI agents into my workflow, my output scales exponentially. This leverage defined my trajectory: moving rapidly from the frontend to leading enterprise backend architecture and DevOps pipelines. I don't just write code—I orchestrate the full stack, from UI to infrastructure, delivering the impact of an entire team.
